title: Audit test suite cost, execution topology, and evidence policy
description:
Audit-and-design pass over the verification system at post-PR-#546 main
(baseline a3a5219). Audit only: no tests deleted, no production code
refactored, no new proof machinery.

DELIVERABLE
docs/audits/test-suite-and-verification/2026-09-14-test-suite-and-verification-audit.md
PR: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/551

KEY MEASURED FINDINGS

1. Raw test count is not the defect. The test:source LOC ratio has been flat
   at ~1.4 since June (1.67 -> 1.40), so suite growth tracks system growth.

2. The OOM is execution topology, not suite size. Vitest maxWorkers defaults
   to availableParallelism() = 20 on a 7.8 GB host whose swap is 91% consumed
   at idle. Measured process-tree peaks: 3,051 MB @ 1 worker, 4,116 MB @ 4,
   4,897 MB @ 6; projected >= 13 GB at the default, which was deliberately
   not executed. Wall clock 181s / 55s / 48s at 1/4/6 workers, so parallelism
   past ~6 buys nothing and costs ~3x the memory.

3. contextAssembler.test.ts:779 runs toEqual on two 7.4 MB Buffers:
   14,354 ms and 2,414 MB, versus 1 ms for Buffer.equals. ~30% of the suite's
   critical path and the largest allocation in the run, protecting a property
   the read-only pack loader boundary already guarantees.

4. The discovery subsystem (~20,700 LOC since July) has discoveryMode
   defaulting to 'off', no production caller, and no root export; for
   measurements.ts, blockerRepairs.ts, traceDerivation.ts and harness.ts the
   test suite is the entire consumer set. Authority is real and current (the
   accepted transition design, Phase 4 still open as eshyra-o9bd.19.15) but
   carries no sunset for experiment scaffolding. Disposition: legitimize with
   an explicit sunset, do NOT retire.

5. The review policy's disposition gate is asymmetric: accepting a finding
   costs nothing extra, rejecting one requires recorded reasoning. That
   asymmetry is the structural driver of contract accretion. Live signature:
   1,103 beads, 100 'Dispatch:' beads, a 15-round rev chain on eshyra-jhpt,
   and tasks reaching attempt 9.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-ON WORK
The audit proposes 13 beads (T1-T13) in section 11, plus amendments to
existing beads rather than duplicates. These are deliberately NOT filed yet:
the document is a proposal, not authority, and filing them before review
would pre-commit the repo to dispositions a reviewer may reject. File them
once the PR is reviewed.

EXISTING BEADS TO UPDATE (not duplicate)
- eshyra-da8d and eshyra-5g3d: this audit supplies the verified cause both
  lack. Note that commit 473424d treated eshyra-da8d by raising a timeout
  budget, which is the symptom layer. Both should be re-examined after a
  worker cap makes them deterministic.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.15: amend with Phase 4 exit dispositions for discovery
  scaffolding.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8: already open and adjacent to the proposed T7;
  reconcile scope before either starts.
- eshyra-tba9: proposes new proof machinery; re-disposition against the
  proposed permanent-evidence policy before building it.

VERIFICATION
format, check, typecheck clean. Tests 5,608 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed.
Test step run at --maxWorkers=6 rather than the unbounded default, because
the audit measures that default as a >= 13 GB projected peak against a
9.8 GB envelope. Worker count does not affect which tests run.
notes:
PR #551 review at head c046c47: CHANGES REQUESTED, three blockers, all in the audit artifact itself. All three verified against the tree and repaired at head 3fe86230.

F3 — claimed 'the test suite is the entire consumer set' for measurements.ts/blockerRepairs.ts/traceDerivation.ts/harness.ts and used root-export absence as evidence. Both wrong: shadow.ts calls observeBlockerRepairs + runDiscoveryStages and orchestrator.ts:883 calls captureDiscoveryShadow, so a real production chain exists, gated off by discoveryMode defaulting to 'off'. Root-export condition also contradicted AGENTS.md (core symbols default to internal). F3/T9 now classify by retained responsibility and real runtime use.

R7 — /usr/bin/time -v reports ru_maxrss = largest single child, not aggregate tree RSS. Verified: 3 children at ~448 MB each (~1.34 GB aggregate) reported 458,656 KB. Would report ~2.5 GB while the tree is at 4.9 GB and show no 4-vs-6-worker difference. R7/T2 now specify process-group sampler or cgroup v2 memory.peak.

F5 — overgeneralized. No authority requires global ADR number uniqueness and the repo already disambiguates by linking the file. Real defect is 3 bare citations (install.md:32, the-hollow-beneath-emberfall-outline.md:20,32). T11 narrowed to those; renumbering and the proposed uniqueness checker dropped. Recorded in-document as an instance of the F6 loop occurring inside the audit that describes it.

Headline measurements and the central test-policy conclusion were not challenged. Approval binds to an exact head SHA, so 3fe86230 needs re-review. Reviewer has not posted the review to GitHub.
